checks.title: AppArmor is enforcing
checks.rationale: AppArmor confines services to defined profiles, limiting blast radius of compromise.
checks.remediation: apt install apparmor apparmor-utils; systemctl enable --now apparmor.

checks.title: nftables service is active
checks.rationale: nftables is Debian 12's default packet filter framework.

checks.title: systemd-timesyncd or chrony is active
checks.command: systemctl is-active systemd-timesyncd 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-active chrony 2>/dev/null || echo inactive
checks.rationale: Accurate time supports log correlation and certificate validity.

checks.title: auditd service is active
checks.rationale: auditd captures kernel/syscall events for forensic analysis.
checks.remediation: apt install auditd; systemctl enable --now auditd.

checks.title: Root SSH login is disabled
checks.rationale: Direct root SSH login is a top-tier attack vector.

checks.title: SSH password authentication is disabled
checks.rationale: Key-only SSH blocks credential brute force.

checks.title: unattended-upgrades service is enabled
checks.rationale: Auto-applied security updates close patch windows.

checks.title: /etc/shadow has no empty password fields
checks.rationale: Accounts with empty passwords allow unauthenticated login.
checks.remediation: passwd -l <user> to lock accounts with empty passwords.

checks.title: Login banner /etc/issue.net is configured
checks.rationale: Pre-login banner provides legal notice and incident-response context.
checks.remediation: Populate /etc/issue.net with the organization's authorized-use banner.

checks.title: Manual: verify /tmp and /var/log are separate filesystems with hardened mount options
checks.audit: Run 'findmnt /tmp /var/log /var/log/audit /dev/shm' and confirm each is a separate mount with nodev,nosuid,noexec where applicable.
checks.rationale: Separate partitions enforce per-mount options and prevent /var fill from blocking the OS.
checks.remediation: Repartition during install or add systemd mount overrides.
